newsitem.title: NORWAY: SOCCER-LATE SOLSKJAER GOAL SAVES NORWAY.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-LATE SOLSKJAER GOAL SAVES NORWAY.

text.p: Ole Gunnar Solskjaer saved Norway from an embarrassing World Cup defeat by Finland with an 83rd minute goal in their group three qualifier on Wednesday.
The 1-1 draw kept Norway, who had a 100 per cent record after three games and a goal tally of 9-0, at the top of the group with 10 points.
Norway dictated the game in the first half but fell behind on the hour to a goal by Antti Sumiala.
The Finns then defended in depth until Solskjaer's late strike.
